hero.title: Health Guidance for Your Next Step
hero.subtitle: RaiderCare helps you understand what to do when you're not feeling well. Share your symptoms, receive clear health guidance, find the right type of healthcare professional, and quickly access emergency help when it matters most.

sectionHeader.title: How RaiderCare Can Help
sectionHeader.subtitle: From understanding symptoms to finding the right care, RaiderCare helps turn health concerns into clear and actionable next steps.

items.title: Symptom Guidance
items.text: Tell RaiderCare what you are experiencing and receive easy-to-understand guidance based on your symptoms, their duration, and severity.

items.title: Smart Care Navigation
items.text: RaiderCare helps identify the most appropriate type of healthcare professional or department for your concern so you know where to go next.

items.title: Immediate Self-Care Guidance
items.text: For non-emergency concerns, RaiderCare provides basic educational steps you may take while monitoring your symptoms or waiting to speak with a healthcare professional.

items.title: Emergency Support
items.text: RaiderCare checks for important warning signs and makes emergency assistance easy to access when symptoms may require immediate medical attention.

items.title: Find a Health Expert
items.text: Based on your health concern, RaiderCare helps guide you toward an appropriate healthcare professional instead of leaving you to search through endless information.

items.title: Private & Secure Experience
items.text: RaiderCare is designed with privacy and security in mind so users can confidently access personalized health navigation and protected account features.

cta.title: Not sure where to start?
cta.text: Tell RaiderCare what you're experiencing. We'll help you understand the next appropriate step and connect you with the right care option.
